subject: Mid-quarter pulse: Q2 OKR status, proposed re-scopes, and QBR prep
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter pulse: Q2 OKR status, proposed re-scopes, and QBR prep

Team —

As we hit the mid-point of Q2 I want to collect a concise pulse for the leadership update and QBR deck. I pulled a summary into the attached Q2_OKR_Pulse_v2.xlsx; please do the following by EOD Friday (2026-06-05):

- Owners: confirm each KRI/KPI row for your objectives with a one-line status (On track / At risk / Off track) and current percent complete.
- Re-scope asks: where an objective cannot meet the current target without disproportionate effort, propose a narrowed target and the rationale.
- Dependencies: flag any cross-team blockers (infra, external partner work, procurement) and list the point person + ETA.

High-level notes from my read:
1) Objective A (Hosted API adoption): green, but need updated adoption numbers for Platform customers. Marcus, can you confirm?
2) Objective B (Dedicated capacity launch): at risk — infra dependency on the tokenized routing service and a missing perf test vector. Dev, need an ETA on the routing fix and whether we should re-scope the SLA target for GA.
3) Objective C (Optimize tooling & costs): on track for perf gains, but we need a small experiment to validate quantization impact on 3rd-party models. Mina, can you run the mini-eval and share results?

For the QBR (week of 2026-06-22) we should land: 2 slides on overall OKR health, 1 slide with re-scopes, 1 slide with top 3 dependencies and mitigation, and a 1-slide ask for executive decisions (credits, hiring, or prioritization). Marcus — can you draft the OKR health slides? Laura — can you pull renewal cues for Pioneer Health and confirm Sarah can join the QBR?

I copied Sarah from Pioneer Health because they're a good case study for Hosted -> Dedicated conversion; Sarah, if you have any updates on their timeline for procurement, please reply or send a short note.

Thanks — short and focused responses please.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Quick update from GTM side:
- Obj A (Hosted API adoption): On track. Week-over-week trials up 18%. I will update the spreadsheet with MTD active customers by EOD Thursday.
- Re-scope proposal: For the pricing experiment in Obj A, propose we reduce the target uplift window from 90 days to 60 days to speed signal (reason: customers are converting faster in initial trials). Thoughts?
- Dependencies: Need updated Dedicated capability dates to firm up conversion messaging. Also request 0.5 PM headcount for the quarter to support the Dedicated case studies — formal ask will go to finance next week.

Will draft the OKR health slides (2 slides) and drop into the Drive link by 6/12.

Grace / team —

On Wed, 3 Jun 2026 at 11:05, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick update from GTM side: ...

Status on routing/tokenized service (Objective B):
- Root cause: an edge case in the token routing table where high-concurrency prefix sequences triggered a fallback path; that fallback is causing a 20–40ms latency spike under synthetic load.
- Fix in progress: patch ready, currently running integration tests against the live KV-caching layer. If tests pass we can canary the change in dedicated-staging next Tue (2026-06-09).
- ETA: Canary 06/09, monitor for 72 hours, then rolling to prod 06/13 if no regressions.
- Consequence: If the canary is delayed >72 hours due to test flakes, we should re-scope the GA SLA target from 99.9 p95 to 99.5 p95 for the GA slide and call out mitigation (caching warmup + temporary burst capacity).

I'll update the pulse spreadsheet with the ETA and the exact tech owner.

—Dev
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

Attachment: routing_fallback_log_excerpt.txt (log snippet)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

On Thu, 4 Jun 2026 at 16:30, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Status on routing/tokenized service (Objective B): ...

Status and recommendation from the Evals/Optimize side:
- Mini-eval run on quantization experiment (Objective C) completed. Results attached in the spreadsheet: gen-quality degradation is under 2% for the target LLM family, inference cost drops ~32% in the test harness.
- Recommendation: Move forward with a limited rollout on non-critical models and add a quality guardrail (prompt-level psych tests + graylist for high-risk customers).
- For Objective B: if the routing canary slips, we should re-scope the Dedicated GA feature set to exclude the low-latency SLA commitment for the first month of GA rather than lowering the long-term SLA — that preserves sales messaging while buying engineering time.

I'll add the detailed eval slides to the Drive link by Friday.

Mina
Principal Applied ML Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick pulses — consolidating decisions so we have single-source for the QBR deck: 

Decisions / actions (owners & due dates):
- Obj A: Marcus to update spreadsheet with MTD customers + pricing experiment scope change (90 -> 60 days). Deliverable: OKR health slide + rationale. Due: 2026-06-12 (in Drive).
- Obj B: Dev to proceed with canary on 06/09; if canary completes successfully, schedule rolling 06/13. If canary slips >72h we RE-SCOPE GA messaging to exclude initial low-latency p95 SLA for month 0 and instead promise capacity + progressive SLA. Dev to update by 06/13 in the pulse doc.
- Obj C: Mina to share quant eval slides and proposed rollout guardrails. Deliverable: 1 slide + CI results. Due: 2026-06-12.
- Dependencies: Marcus to include Dedicated dates and a short note on required 0.5 PM FTE in the executive ask slide. Laura to confirm Pioneer Health procurement timeline and whether Sarah will join the QBR; Sarah — any update appreciated.

QBR deck plan: Marcus + Grace to own OKR health slides; Mina to own the Optimize/quant slides; Dev to provide a short tech-risk mitigation slide. Final deck target: 2026-06-17 COB.

If there are objections to the re-scope approach above, call them out now; otherwise I'll finalize slides and the executive ask (0.5 PM + temporary credits for key pilots) and circulate for approval.

Thanks — short replies if you're blocked.

—Grace
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
